_README: Hand labels for proposal 022 and the signal scoring in 022-signals-scored.mjs.
QUESTION: do these two functions DO THE SAME THING?
SAME = one operation, differing only by data (entity, template key, table, endpoint).
DIFF = they share a skeleton (framework or library idiom) but perform unrelated work.
These labels are a JUDGEMENT, not a derivation. They were assigned by reading all 153
pairs in one pass against the rule above. Disagree with one? Flip its label and re-run
the scorer — that is what this file is for. The boundary cases are publish-vs-unpublish,
create-vs-update, and opposite-direction transforms, all labelled DIFF.
minLines(10), similarity >= 0.9, stratified over (similarity band x body size).
